answer: In our elder-care agent economy, each caregiver identity is bound to a verified trust vertex in a sharded attestation graph, where a lightweight kernel validates signed care-history proofs before any new agent can transact. A raven-like watchdog layer cross-checks these proofs against kin and agency records, flagging duplicate or colluding registrations that reuse. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
